title: Our Process
subtitle: A clear and guided journey from onboarding to growth optimization.

steps.title: Payment made
steps.text: Complete the payment. We'll send you the company driver to collect the money. Or you can pay via Whish or OMT.

steps.title: WhatsApp group
steps.text: Within 24 hours, we create a WhatsApp group and schedule a kickoff meeting.

steps.title: Kickoff meeting
steps.text: We align on style, branding direction, and color palette.

steps.title: Content and script creation
steps.text: Our team prepares 20 content ideas and scripts, then reviews them with you.

steps.title: Shooting and editing
steps.text: Professional shooting session followed by editing, captions, and thumbnails.

steps.title: Approval and posting
steps.text: We secure your approval and post strategically across four platforms.

steps.title: Analysis result
steps.text: We analyze performance and optimize the next content cycle.
